scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names vision,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:vision" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @courtvision/contracts && npm run build -w @courtvision/agent && npm run build -w @courtvision/renderer && npm run build -w @courtvision/web
scripts.build:showcase: npm run showcase:prepare && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @courtvision/infra -- --profile nba
scripts.check:local: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
